verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only qualitative speed language, such as priority requests getting 'faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput' and flex having 'slower response times.' It shows no published tokens-per-second figures, latency benchmarks or load-testing guides from DeepInfra. The single community remark about cold-start being '<10s' is an informal comment, not a published benchmark backing the provider's speed claims.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims
